translations.t0038: Technical inability to carry out the act independently is an assessment — a technically competent accomplice is theoretically possible, but finds no support in the file.
translations.t0039: Hofer's alibi for the night of the offence (Friday evening) rests on a dinner with his former partner. It is unclear whether a calendar entry, a restaurant receipt, or a confirmation from the former partner exists on file.
translations.t0040: The garage log shows an exit at 16:48 (uncorrected) on Friday 10.10. It must be checked whether a re-entry during the night of 10./11. October was logged for SG 219 004 — a missing entry would strengthen the vehicle alibi.
translations.t0041: The card feed could show a transaction on Friday evening that evidences Hofer's presence away from the office (restaurant visit with former partner).
translations.t0042: Hofer cites incident INC-0412 as his Saturday alibi, placing him at the office from approximately 13:00. It must be checked whether the incident channel or associated logs cover Saturday night activity (02:00) or exclusively Saturday afternoon.
translations.t0043: Yannick Favre independently confirms a 4-hour video call with Hofer on Saturday — relevant as an independent voice. It must be checked whether telecommunications data or further records document this call.
translations.t0044: Hofer mentions a calendar entry ('something personal in the calendar') for the dinner with his former partner. Whether this calendar entry is actually present in the file must be verified.
translations.t0045: Hofer's alibi for the night of the offence (Friday 10 October, 23:10–05:58 CEST) is weak: he claims to have been at home, citing as his sole evidence a neighbour's barking dog. No independent source confirms his absence from the office that night. The garage log shows an exit at 16:48 (system clock, uncorrected; actually approximately 17:48 CEST due to winter time offset) on Friday — thereafter no further entry for SG 219 004 until Saturday 11:58 (uncorrected; actually approximately 12:58 CEST).
translations.t0046: Hofer possesses all relevant knowledge prerequisites: real/decoy distinction, undocumented staging path, decompression property of the bundles, logging window. He appears on Ammann's original list of five.
translations.t0047: Hofer was passed over for the CTO position in August and responded with two weeks of silence; in April he made very sharp remarks about the Kestrel process in a meeting.
translations.t0048: On Saturday 11 October, Hofer purchased portable NVMe drives at Digitec and was in the building from approximately 12:58 CEST (corrected garage log) — shortly after the exfiltration concluded (05:58 CEST) and logging was restored (06:00 CEST).
translations.t0049: Hofer cites a dinner with his former partner (daughter, school) and, according to the garage log, left at approximately 17:48 CEST on Friday and did not return until approximately 12:58 CEST on Saturday. No vehicle re-entry during the night can be demonstrated. A calendar entry for this dinner is not traceable in the file; the neighbour/dog is not verifiable. The night of the offence (23:10–05:58 CEST) is therefore neither positively evidenced nor refuted.
translations.t0050: Hofer's vehicle left the garage at approximately 17:48 CEST (system clock +1h) and, according to the available log, did not return before Saturday 12:58 CEST.
translations.t0051: The next entry for SG 219 004 is Saturday 11:58 system time (approximately 12:58 CEST); no entry during the night was logged.
translations.t0052: Hofer himself concedes that his alibi for that night is not robust. The former partner is not mentioned or confirmed in any other source. A calendar record for the dinner is absent from the file.
translations.t0053: Hofer's knowledge derives legitimately from his role as VP Engineering and builder of the pipeline. He has been with the company since before 2023, approved INFRA-2291, personally reviewed all diligence documents for Tier 3, and assisted Ammann in sizing the decoys.
translations.t0054: Hofer provides a legitimate explanation for his detailed technical knowledge of the artefacts: active oversight of the diligence process.
translations.t0055: Hofer was directly involved in decoy development — a legitimate source of real/decoy knowledge.
translations.t0056: Hofer approved the logging window in his official capacity — he knew of it through his role, not through privileged insider knowledge.
translations.t0057: Hofer acknowledges his dissatisfaction with the CTO decision and the Kestrel process himself, but relativises it: he declined two offers with double compensation and describes MERIDIAN as the most important work of his life. Vogel, who was closest to the Kestrel process, does not believe Hofer is behind the exfiltration.
translations.t0058: Hofer cites a plausible counter-motive: his emotional attachment to MERIDIAN as the defining work of his life makes sabotage subjectively self-destructive for him.
translations.t0059: Vogel's assessment supports Hofer's own account — not an independent fact, but a corroborating statement.
translations.t0060: Hofer's own statements evidence strong negative emotions towards the Kestrel process; this contradicts the picture of complete emotional detachment.
translations.t0061: The CTO decision was a board resolution against Dov's wishes — Hofer being passed over was a deliberate external decision, not an internal compromise.
translations.t0062: The Digitec purchase is evidenced by expense report, card feed, and incident INC-0412 and is explained as follows: the sandbox node sbx-07 had a faulty disk; the incident was led by Hofer in the #incidents channel from 13:01 CEST; Yannick Favre participated for four hours via video call. The purchase of NVMe drives is consistent with the documented incident.
translations.t0063: The official expense narrative links the purchase to the documented incident INC-0412 and a specific asset tag.
translations.t0064: Hofer opens the incident channel at 13:01 CEST (UTC+2) on Saturday and documents his presence therein.
translations.t0065: Hofer leaves the building at 17:48 CEST (Slack timestamp UTC+2); the garage log shows an exit at 16:52 system time (approximately 17:52 CEST) — consistent.
translations.t0066: Yannick Favre independently confirms the four-hour Saturday call with Hofer from Val Müstair.
translations.t0067: The purchase is approved and documented with an asset tag; no contradiction, but the purchase itself evidences only the transaction, not the exclusive purpose of the drives.
translations.t0068: Fully present and legitimately explicable: VP Engineering since before 2023, builder of the pipeline, actively involved in decoy development, approved INFRA-2291 in an official capacity, personally controlled the diligence documents. The knowledge is a necessary condition, but for a person in Hofer's role it is not a sufficient one.
translations.t0069: Physical access on Saturday 11 October from approximately 12:58 CEST is evidenced (garage log, Slack, badge entry via lobby mentioned). For the night of the offence (23:10 Friday to 05:58 Saturday CEST), no evidenced access and no evidenced vehicle in the garage log. The alley door is unbadged and propped — access without a vehicle would be unlogged and possible. No evidence either confirms or rules out physical presence during the night of the offence.
translations.t0070: For the night of the offence (23:10–05:58 CEST) there is no alibi supported by independent evidence. Hofer's vehicle left the garage at approximately 17:48 CEST on Friday and does not reappear until approximately 12:58 CEST on Saturday. No card, Slack, or other activity during the night of the offence is documented. Saturday afternoon (approximately 13:00–17:48 CEST) is coherently evidenced by multiple independent sources (Slack INC-0412, Yannick Favre, garage log) and does not overlap temporally with the exfiltration.
translations.t0071: For the entire night of the offence (23:10 Friday to 05:58 Saturday CEST) there is no independent evidence of Hofer's absence from the scene. The garage log shows no vehicle return, but also does not evidence a visit (access via the unbadged alley door would be unlogged). The stated dinner with the former partner cannot be verified through any calendar, card, or other source on file.
translations.t0072: Hofer is among the few individuals who simultaneously possess all three knowledge prerequisites (Real/Decoy Mapping, undocumented staging path, decompression property). Only Andrin Caduff and Iris Ammann share this complete knowledge set; Iris is exculpated by Lisbon records, Yannick Favre by Val Müstair.
translations.t0073: Hofer's Saturday afternoon is coherently evidenced by multiple independent sources and falls after the exfiltration — this exculpates him for that period. His knowledge is legitimately explicable. However, for the actual night of the offence (23:10–05:58 CEST) there is not a single independent piece of evidence of his absence. The garage log shows no nocturnal re-entry, but does not rule out access via the unbadged alley door. The claimed dinner with the former partner is not documented in the file. The conditions (knowledge, access, no refuted time window) remain possible. No positive incriminating evidence, but equally no robust exculpation.
translations.t0074: Hofer's presence on Saturday afternoon is coherently evidenced by Slack, the garage log, and Yannick Favre's independent statement, and falls temporally after the exfiltration. For the actual night of the offence, however, every independent verification of his claimed alibi is absent; the knowledge and access conditions remain satisfied; the case remains open.
translations.t0075: The dinner with the former partner on Friday evening is not evidenced in any calendar, card, or other file; the former partner was not interviewed.
translations.t0076: According to multiple sources, the alley door is unbadged and was propped — building entry without a vehicle and without a badge trace would be possible for any suspect, including Hofer.
translations.t0077: The card feed contains no transaction from Hofer on Friday evening 10 October that would support or contradict an absence from the office.
translations.t0078: Hofer's garage log shows no nocturnal re-entry — this is consistent with having driven home, but equally consistent with access via the alley door (unbadged, propped).
translations.t0079: The complete knowledge combination (Real/Decoy + staging path + decompression) is shared, according to the file, only by Hofer, Caduff, and Ammann; Ammann is exculpated by Lisbon records, Favre by Val Müstair — Hofer remains without comparable independent exculpation for the night of the offence.
translations.t0080: The question of whether Andrin Caduff's eval sweep on the night of the offence could technically have been exploited for the exfiltration or constituted an independent access path has not been conclusively resolved and indirectly affects the assessment of all remaining suspects.
translations.t0081: Check whether Rochat was on the distribution list for the Q1 board pack (Feb 2025, Slide 11: Real/Decoy mapping) — the email headers and distribution list determine whether she had a legitimate knowledge path to K1.
translations.t0082: Rochat claims she drove to Bern after 22:30 and stayed overnight at her sister's. Card or hotel records from Bern on the night of the offence would support her alibi.
translations.t0083: Garage entries and exits for Saturday 11.10. through Monday 13.10. would show whether Rochat's vehicle did not return to the building after the night of the offence until Monday — consistent with a stay in Bern.
translations.t0084: Rochat charged fuel at Thurau motorway station (22:47 CEST, A1 westbound) and Würenlos (23:29 CEST, A1 westbound) — direction Bern plausible. Is there a corresponding return journey eastbound over the weekend?
translations.t0085: According to meeting notes (MT-L503/EM-L16), Noemi presented Slides 5–8 (Product) in the Q1 board pack. As the presenting executive she was part of the standard distribution list — this would constitute a legitimate pathway to Slide 11 containing the Real/Decoy mapping.
translations.t0086: The page had 16 views from 9 accounts. Rochat's account could be among those 9 (she mentions reading it in April). Page analytics data would confirm or refute whether her account appears in the access list.
translations.t0087: Rochat left the garage at 22:28 CEST according to the corrected garage log (raw value 21:28, +1h clock correction). By her own account she was in office 2F-4 on the second floor until approximately 22:30. The offence began at 23:10 CEST, approximately 40 minutes after her departure. The office is directly adjacent to the engineering floor access, and the scene was physically reachable. The gap is tight, but real.
translations.t0088: Rochat read the Confluence page on storage controls once in April. She is therefore aware of the concept of decoy bundles. As the presenting executive (Product, Slides 5–8) in the Q1 board pack, she was also on the distribution list for the deck containing Slide 11 with the Real/Decoy mapping.
translations.t0089: Rochat's office 2F-4 is directly adjacent, through a sound-permeable wall, to room 2F-3, which investigator Arslan used from 14 November onwards. On 20.11., Arslan held a 40-minute speakerphone call with forensic examiner Bakalian about the forensic findings. Rochat stated that she was in her office daily.
translations.t0090: During her interview, Rochat described the sequence of events in exceptional detail (disk full, snapshot deleted, job restarted from the beginning) and called it 'amateur hour'. The investigator had explicitly withheld these details; no Halcyon employee should have known them before their interviews.
translations.t0091: After leaving the garage at 22:28 CEST, Rochat drove westbound on the A1 towards Bern: card payments evidence Raststätte Thurau (22:47 CEST, approximately 30 km west of St. Gallen) and Raststätte Würenlos (23:29 CEST, approximately 80 km west). At 23:10 CEST — the moment the offence began — Rochat's vehicle was demonstrably on the A1 motorway between Thurau and Würenlos according to card data, i.e. far from the engineering floor. A return to the scene would not have been physically possible within the approximately 40 minutes between leaving the garage and the start of the offence, as Thurau was already charged before the offence began.
